<thought>We need a single retrosynthetic step that disconnects the target into a ketone and an alkyne via a cycloaddition. The forward reaction loses a ketone and a C‑C triple bond, forming a new C‑C bond and breaking a C‑O bond. I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a ketone (C=O) and a C‑C triple bond, forming a C‑C single bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C-C triple bond"],
  "functional_groups_formed": null,
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
